text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Nishino Flower suffers an injury during training, so I rush her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: It seems like I'm in worse shape than I thought…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I know I shouldn't, but I'm still going to ask…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I want to become an Umamusume who inspires courage in people. I can't let some injury stop me.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I understand I can't do much… but can we please keep training?
choice_data_list: Okay. Let's find out what you can do.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: But while I'm resting, everyone else will still be making progress…
choice_data_list: Overdoing things even when you know you shouldn't is foolish.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Urgh… I'm sorry… I just don't want to get left behind…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: But I shouldn't be impatient… I'll take it easy until I'm fully healed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Nishino Flower looks a little disappointed as she returns to her dorm.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much, Trainer! I'll do my best! Promise!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Sorry, but it hurts more than I thought it would…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I guess I'll have to put my training on hold for a while…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seemingly in quite a bit of pain, Nishino Flower slowly limps back to her dorm.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Looks like I can handle light exercise just fine!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'll do what I can without pushing too hard!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Nishino Flower looks very satisfied and successfully completes her training session while taking care not to aggravate her injury.
